new_roles.description:
**Description**

 
 
 
 

Title: Sr. Manager, Quality SME (BESS) 
Department: EHSQ / Quality 
Location: Houston, TX

Supervisor: Sr. Director of Quality 
Direct Reports: None 
FLSA Status: Exempt 
Position Status: Permanent, Full-time

Work Status (Remote/Hybrid/In-Office): Remote

Sr. Manager, Quality SME (BESS)

Hanwha Qcells USA Corp (“HQC US”) develops, invests, and delivers solar photovoltaic (PV) and battery energy storage systems (BESS) projects through Engineering, Procurement, Construction (EPC) services in North America.

The company brings a decade of global leadership in solar PV to deliver utility-scale power generation plants customized for local and regional energy markets. HQC US offers the full spectrum of PV solutions – from the core technology of cells and modules to large-scale project development and investment. With proven capabilities across the solar and battery storage chain, HQC US minimizes uncertainty and risk, and helps customers achieve a higher return on their investment in renewable energy.

SUMMARY

The Sr. Manager, Quality SME (BESS) (“Quality SME”) serves as the company’s subject matter expert and technical authority for Quality on Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) construction. The Quality SME is responsible for developing and maintaining the processes, systems, Inspection & Test Plan (ITP) templates, Quality Control Verification Checklists, and Standard Work Instructions (SWIs) that govern how Quality is planned, executed, and documented on BESS scopes, whether self-performed or subcontracted. The role covers both standalone BESS facilities and BESS integrated with utility-scale solar PV projects.

The Quality SME works alongside the Regional Quality Managers on every project with active BESS construction, integrating discipline requirements into the project Quality program and providing technical direction to the Quality Field Leads and Quality Inspectors hired for these scopes. Those personnel report to the assigned Site Quality Manager or Sr. Site Quality Manager, who remains the single point of contact and the ranking Quality authority on site. The Quality SME holds a matrixed line of technical direction to the discipline team, participates in hiring, onboarding, training, and performance input, and is accountable for the technical consistency, process discipline, and record integrity of BESS Quality across the portfolio.

Success in this role requires deep practical knowledge of utility-scale BESS construction, including equipment foundations and anchorage, battery enclosures and containers, power conversion systems (PCS) and inverters, medium-voltage transformers, auxiliary power, DC and AC cabling and terminations, grounding and bonding, thermal management systems, and fire detection, suppression, gas detection, and explosion control installation interfaces. Equally important is a working command of manufacturer-specific installation, preservation, and warranty requirements, which often govern acceptance more directly than the project drawings. The Quality SME aligns closely with the Engineering and BESS teams to integrate Quality early and resolve technical questions consistently. Design interpretation, battery management and energy management system configuration, functional commissioning, and capacity testing remain with Engineering, Commissioning, and the manufacturer; the Quality SME ensures those interfaces are defined, documented, and respected.

This position reports directly to the Senior Director of Quality (or another designated member of senior management). The role is remote, with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. local time, or as site construction hours dictate during jobsite visits. Travel is required up to 50% of the time, which includes scheduled jobsite visits for oversight and technical authority, as well as short-notice trips and extended site visits as business needs dictate.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTION & RESPONSIBILITIES

 

* Serve as the company’s subject matter expert and technical authority for Quality on standalone and PV-integrated BESS construction, supporting the Senior Director of Quality and the Regional Quality Managers.
* Develop, own, and maintain company-standard ITP templates, Quality Control Verification Checklists, SWIs, and Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) content for BESS scopes, ensuring they reflect current engineering standards, manufacturer requirements, and lessons learned.
* Build and maintain BESS inspection templates and workflows in Procore, in coordination with Quality Systems, so that discipline inspections are performed and recorded consistently across all projects.
* Integrate with the assigned Regional Quality Manager on each project containing BESS scope, from pre-mobilization planning through turnover, confirming discipline requirements are incorporated into the Site-Specific Quality Management Plan (SSQMP), ITPs, inspection staffing plan, and inspection schedule.
* Support the Preconstruction Quality SME by tailoring discipline ITPs and checklists for project kickoff packages and identifying BESS-specific contract, manufacturer, testing, and authority having jurisdiction (AHJ) requirements.
* Provide technical direction to the BESS Quality Field Leads and Quality Inspectors assigned to projects, in coordination with the Site Quality Manager, who retains administrative supervision and day-to-day site direction.
* Participate in recruitment, technical interviewing, onboarding, and qualification of discipline Quality Field Leads and Quality Inspectors, and provide performance input to the Site Quality Manager and Regional Quality Manager.
* Develop and deliver discipline-specific training for Quality personnel, covering acceptance criteria, inspection methods, manufacturer requirements, documentation requirements, and common BESS failure modes.
* Conduct scheduled jobsite visits to verify implementation of the BESS Quality program, perform surveillance of field inspection activities, and audit discipline records in Procore for accuracy, completeness, traceability, and objective evidence.
* Provide technical review and approval of subcontractor Quality Control Plans, ITPs, and inspection forms for BESS scopes prior to acceptance by the Site Quality Manager, and verify subcontractor Quality performance through surveillance and audit.
* Provide technical review and concurrence on proposed repair and use-as-is dispositions for nonconformances within the discipline, and on other dispositions as requested by the Site Quality Manager, in coordination with Engineering and the manufacturer.
* Lead or support root cause analysis for significant or recurring BESS nonconformances, and drive corrective and preventive actions to closure across the portfolio.
* Exercise stop-work authority for quality-driven conditions in accordance with company policy, coordinating through the Site Quality Manager as the single point of contact on site.
* Elevate unresolved technical disagreements with site Quality, Construction, subcontractor, or manufacturer personnel to the Regional Quality Manager and Senior Director of Quality, with a documented position and recommended resolution.
* Define Quality’s verification requirements for receiving, storage, preservation, handling, and installation of BESS equipment, including manufacturer limits on storage conditions, storage duration, and state-of-charge maintenance that affect product conformity and warranty.
* Verify that manufacturer installation checklists, field service requirements, and warranty-related documentation are integrated into ITPs and completed in sequence, and coordinate Quality activities with manufacturer field representatives.
* Review pre-commissioning and construction test records, including torque verification, insulation resistance, and continuity testing, for completeness and conformance with project specifications, manufacturer requirements, and ANSI/NETA ATS where applicable.
* Define and support Quality’s responsibilities within the functional testing and cold commissioning RACI and in mechanical completion, energization-readiness, and turnover verification for BESS systems, while maintaining clear separation from battery management system configuration, functional commissioning, and capacity testing responsibilities.
* Where required by contract and as directed by the Senior Director of Quality, support factory acceptance test (FAT) witnessing and source inspection of BESS enclosures, PCS, and transformers, and contribute to the development of a formal source inspection program as the organization establishes one.
* Coordinate with owner’s engineers, independent engineers, AHJs, fire officials, and third-party agencies on BESS Quality matters, including inspection and documentation requirements associated with fire and life-safety systems.
* Align closely with the Engineering and BESS teams to resolve technical questions, participate in design and constructability reviews, and maintain consistent acceptance criteria across projects and manufacturers.
* Monitor BESS Quality KPIs and nonconformance trends across the portfolio, and report findings, emerging risks, and recommendations to the Senior Director of Quality.
* Provide input on discipline staffing and resource planning, including the number and qualification of Quality Field Leads and Quality Inspectors and third-party testing needs, for estimating and project staffing plans.
* Define the BESS Quality records required for turnover and verify completeness of discipline turnover documentation, including manufacturer and warranty records.
* Capture lessons learned from executed projects and incorporate them into discipline templates, training, and the broader Quality Management System (QMS).
* Interact and collaborate cross-functionally with Engineering, BESS, Construction, Commissioning, Subcontract Management, and Safety teams to embed Quality into project execution.
* Perform other duties and special projects, as assigned.
* Travel is required up to 50%, including scheduled jobsite visits, extended site visits, short-notice trips, and overnight stays.

KEY COMPETENCIES / CORE SKILLS

 

* Recognized technical authority who guides others through credibility and clear reasoning rather than positional authority.
* Translates engineering, manufacturer, code, and contract requirements into clear, inspectable acceptance criteria.
* Builds standardized tools, including ITPs, checklists, SWIs, and Procore templates, that scale across projects, manufacturers, and delivery models.
* Leads effectively within a matrixed structure, supporting the Site Quality Manager as the single point of contact while holding the technical standard for the discipline.
* Holds the standard under schedule and commercial pressure while maintaining professional, collaborative working relationships with project teams and manufacturers.
* Understands the boundaries between construction Quality, Engineering, manufacturer responsibilities, and Commissioning, and escalates appropriately.
* Maintains exceptional attention to detail across inspection records, preservation records, test reports, and supporting objective evidence.
* Analyzes deficiency trends across the portfolio and translates findings into durable process change.
* Communicates clearly and factually with field personnel, engineers, manufacturers, owners, AHJs, and executive leadership, both in writing and in person.
* Coaches and develops discipline Quality Field Leads and Quality Inspectors, treating development of the bench as a core responsibility.
* Manages multiple concurrent projects, travel demands, and shifting priorities while maintaining accountability.
* Maintains composure and a solutions-focused approach under pressure, disagreement, and challenging field conditions.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

* Minimum of 10 years of progressive quality experience in utility-scale renewable-energy, utility, or industrial construction, including at least 5 years of direct Quality responsibility on utility-scale BESS projects; utility-scale PV experience alone does not satisfy this requirement.
* At least 5 years in a quality leadership or management role, including directing inspection personnel or leading Quality programs across multiple projects.
* Demonstrated experience authoring and maintaining ITPs, Quality Inspection Checklists, Standard Work Instructions, and procedures for BESS construction.
* Strong working knowledge of BESS construction, including equipment foundations and anchorage, battery enclosures and containers, PCS and inverter equipment, medium-voltage transformers, auxiliary systems, DC and AC cabling and terminations, grounding and bonding, thermal management systems, and fire detection and suppression installation interfaces.
* Demonstrated experience applying manufacturer-specific installation, preservation, and warranty requirements for utility-scale energy storage equipment.
* Demonstrated ability to read and apply IFC drawings, single-line diagrams, equipment layouts, grounding plans, cable schedules, specifications, approved submittals, and manufacturer installation manuals.
* Experience overseeing Quality on both self-performed and subcontracted BESS work, including review of subcontractor Quality Control Plans and ITPs.
* Experience coordinating Quality activities with manufacturer field representatives, owner’s engineers, independent engineers, testing agencies, and AHJs.
* Demonstrated experience with nonconformance management, root cause analysis methodology (5-Why, fishbone, fault tree, or equivalent), and corrective action programs.
* Demonstrated understanding of the boundaries between construction Quality, Engineering, manufacturer, and Commissioning responsibilities.
* Proficiency with Procore (Quality & Field Management modules) and SharePoint.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint).
* Ability to work remotely with a reliable high-speed internet connection and flexibility to support projects across Eastern through Pacific Time Zones as required.
* Must hold and maintain a valid U.S. driver’s license and have the ability to safely operate a motor vehicle, including the ability to rent vehicles for business travel without restrictions that would interfere with job performance.
* Ability to successfully pass a motor vehicle/driving record background check in accordance with company policy.
* Must be able to pass pre-employment, regular, and random drug and alcohol screenings in compliance with company and customer requirements.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Construction Management, or a related technical discipline.
* Professional certifications such as:
 + American Society for Quality (ASQ): Certified Manager of Quality/Organizational Excellence (CMQ/OE), Certified Construction Quality Manager (CCQM), Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA)
 + North American Board of Certified Energy Practitioners (NABCEP): Energy Storage Installation Professional (ESIP) or PV Installation Professional (PVIP)
 + InterNational Electrical Testing Association (NETA): NETA Certified Technician, Level III or Level IV
 + Manufacturer credentials: Installation or field service certification on one or more utility-scale BESS platforms
 + Electrical licensing: State journeyman or master electrician license
 + Project Management Institute (PMI): Project Management Professional (PMP)
* Experience witnessing factory acceptance testing or performing source inspection of BESS enclosures, PCS, or transformers.
* Experience across multiple BESS manufacturers, battery technologies, PCS platforms, thermal management designs, and both AC-coupled and DC-coupled configurations.
* Working knowledge of NFPA 855, NEC (NFPA 70) Article 706, UL 9540 and UL 9540A, and the energy storage provisions of the International Fire Code.
* Experience supporting BESS mechanical completion, construction completion, or commissioning-readiness documentation.
* Working knowledge of ISO 9001 and formal Quality Management System requirements.
* Experience developing and delivering technical training for Quality or field personnel.
* Advanced proficiency with Procore, including inspection template configuration, reporting, and workflow design, as well as Power BI.
* Experience supporting utility-scale solar PV, medium-voltage collection, or substation scopes adjacent to BESS installations.
* Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish, with the ability to communicate effectively across diverse project teams.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

 

* Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods while operating a computer and reviewing documentation, drawings, and test records.
* Ability to effectively exchange accurate information in verbal and written form with employees, contractors, manufacturers, and external stakeholders.
* Ability to conduct regular jobsite visits requiring extended standing and walking on uneven or unpaved terrain, as well as bending, stooping, kneeling, and climbing stairs or ladders to access BESS enclosures and equipment areas.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds of inspection equipment, documentation, or other work-related materials as required.
* Ability to perform field activities while wearing required personal protective equipment (PPE), including hard hat, safety glasses, gloves, high-visibility clothing, safety footwear, and arc-rated clothing or other project-specific PPE where required.
* Ability to safely access BESS and electrical construction areas in accordance with site safety requirements, electrical safe-work practices, BESS-specific hazard controls, and access controls.
* Ability to travel domestically up to 50% of the time, including by air, with flexibility for short-notice trips, overnight stays, and extended site visits.
* Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

 

* Work is divided between a remote/home office environment, requiring reliable high-speed internet and standard office equipment, including audio/video conferencing, and active construction sites.
* Field work is performed at utility-scale BESS, solar, and substation construction sites, where conditions may include outdoor weather exposure, dust, moderate to high noise levels, moving construction equipment, and uneven terrain. Appropriate PPE will be provided and required.
* Field work regularly occurs in proximity to energized or potentially energized equipment and stored-energy hazards as projects progress toward energization, requiring strict adherence to electrical safety requirements, BESS hazard controls, and access controls.
* Work schedules during jobsite visits may vary based on construction activities, manufacturer availability, testing schedules, and project milestones, and may include early starts, extended hours, or weekends.
* Regular interaction with cross-functional teams in both virtual and in-person settings, requiring adaptability to both independent and collaborative work environments.

new_roles.title: Senior Manager, Supplier Quality (R6220)
new_roles.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

### **Job Description:**

Shield AI is actively seeking candidates with deep expertise in manufacturing and quality methodologies, paired with a relentless drive to enable supplier success and strengthen mission-critical operations.

Shield AI’s Supply Chain Quality team is responsible for global quality oversight across our supplier base. The team reduces supply-chain risk through supplier assessments and internal risk reviews, proactively drives supplier qualification and development activities.

In this role, you will lead a supplier quality team responsible for supplier qualification, development, performance management, and quality assurance across Shield AI’s aerospace and defense supply base. You will set supplier-quality priorities; manage team capacity, technical execution, and resource allocation; and develop high-performing quality leaders. The role also oversees supplier audits, nonconformance resolution, root-cause investigations, and hands on hardware dispositions.

You will evaluate supplier capability, quality performance, organizational risk, and resource needs to ensure purchased hardware and materials meet Shield AI engineering, customer, regulatory, and quality requirements. As an experienced aerospace quality leader, you will partner closely with Supply Chain, Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, and Program teams to resolve complex supplier-quality issues, improve supplier capability, and reduce quality and delivery risk across the supply base.

**What you'll do:**

* Develop the supplier quality team responsible for supplier qualification, surveillance, performance management, and corrective-action activities across Shield AI’s global aerospace and defense supply base.
* Establish supplier-quality priorities, allocate resources, and translate functional objectives into staffing, workload, and execution plans that support product, program, and organizational needs.
* Develop Supplier Quality leaders and engineering personnel through coaching, performance management, succession planning, workforce development, and technical mentorship.
* Oversee supplier qualification, risk assessments, periodic performance reviews, supplier audits, source inspections, and approved-supplier status across complex aerospace hardware, commodities, and manufacturing processes.
* Ensure supplier requirements are effectively flowed down and that suppliers comply with applicable quality management system, engineering, customer, contractual, regulatory, and statutory requirements.
* Escalate significant supplier-quality risks and direct SCARs, supplier recovery efforts, and capability-improvement plans that could affect product quality, delivery, mission readiness, or program execution.
* Partner with Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Supply Chain, and Program teams to address supplier producibility, design-for-manufacturability, process capability, technical execution, and quality risks.
* Advance supplier-quality processes, business systems, data analytics, and continuous-improvement practices that strengthen supplier capability, product quality, delivery performance, and supply-base resilience.

**Required qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, or another related technical discipline.
* At least 7 years of relevant experience, including 2–5 years of leadership or people-management experience with direct responsibility for Quality Engineering and/or Supplier Quality Engineering personnel.
* Strong working knowledge of AS9100 and/or ISO 9001 quality-management systems, as well as aerospace and defense supplier-quality requirements.
* Demonstrated proficiency in root-cause analysis and structured problem-solving methods, including 8D, 5 Whys, and fishbone analysis.
* Experience with supplier qualification, supplier development, PPAP, and First Article Inspection processes, including AS9102 requirements.
* Understanding of ITAR, EAR, DFARS, and other requirements applicable to aerospace and defense suppliers.
* Demonstrated people-leadership capability, including coaching, performance management, organizational development, and building high-performing technical teams.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration, executive communication, and supplier relationship-management skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook.
* Experience using ERP/MRP systems.
* Ability to travel to Shield AI manufacturing locations and supplier sites domestically and, as needed, internationally—up to approximately 20% of the time.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Quality Manager (CQM), or equivalent quality certification.
* Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Experience leading supplier-quality functions in a high-growth aerospace, defense, autonomy, robotics, or advanced-manufacturing environment.
* Experience supporting the production and qualification of complex electromechanical, electronic, precision-machined, composite, or avionics hardware.

new_roles.description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

**Environmental Conditions**

Office

**Job Description**

Here at Thermo Fisher Scientific, our industry-leading scale means unparalleled commercial reach, unique customer access, and a global footprint. Our broad customer base—from research and clinical laboratories to commercial manufacturing—enables you to make a meaningful impact every day. Join our team and help build the capabilities that enable exceptional customer service across one of the world's largest scientific organizations.

**Location**: On-site in Tewksbury, MA is highly preferred; *potential* flexibility for remote candidates aligned to Eastern Time Zone. Relocation assistance is NOT provided.

* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.
* Must be able to pass a comprehensive background check, which includes a drug screening.

**Position Summary**

The **Director of Product Management & Global Operations** is responsible for defining and advancing the global capabilities that enable consistent, scalable, and industry-leading service delivery across Thermo Fisher Scientific's global service organization.

Reporting into this role are the leaders responsible for Service Product Management, Service Platforms, and our Global Technical Support leaders representing a global organization of approximately 100 colleagues.

This leader establishes the strategy, governance, and operational frameworks that enable service excellence through standardized processes, knowledge management, digital service platforms, technical support, escalation management, and service lifecycle governance. Working across Product Management, Engineering, Digital, Commercial, Quality, and Regional Service organizations, the Global Service Capability Leader ensures service teams worldwide have the tools, processes, knowledge, and capabilities needed to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Global Service Capability Strategy**

* Define and execute the global strategy for service capabilities aligned with business growth objectives.
* Develop enterprise standards that improve service consistency, efficiency, and customer experience across all regions.
* Build scalable operational frameworks supporting future growth and digital transformation.
* Establish governance for global service capabilities and operational excellence initiatives.

**Service Lifecycle Management**

* Lead the global governance of service lifecycle management from New Product Introduction (NPI) through End-of-Life (EOL).
* Ensure global service readiness for new products, software, and technologies.
* Partner with Product Management and Engineering to establish supportability requirements early in product development.
* Standardize lifecycle planning, service documentation, training, spare parts readiness, and support models.

**Knowledge Management & Service Enablement**

* Own the global knowledge management strategy supporting service engineers and technical support organizations.
* Develop standardized technical content, troubleshooting guides, repair procedures, and digital knowledge assets.

new_roles.title: Operations Director
new_roles.description:
Job Overview

The Operations Director will oversee the company's day to day operations and work closely with leadership to ensure that business objectives are being met. This role is responsible for managing operational performance, supporting department managers, improving internal processes, and making sure teams have the direction and resources they need to do their jobs effectively.

You will work across finance, sales, customer service, and project management to keep business activities organized and running smoothly. The right person understands how to manage people and resources, keep an eye on financial performance, and address operational problems before they affect the business.

Responsibilities

Oversee daily business operations and work with department managers to establish priorities, assign responsibilities, and maintain consistent performance across teams.

Monitor profit and loss performance, review operating expenses, and work with finance to manage budgets and improve financial results.

Use financial reports, operational data, and Microsoft Excel to evaluate performance, identify problems, and support day to day business decisions.

Manage operational projects and process improvement initiatives, looking for practical ways to reduce unnecessary costs, improve efficiency, and strengthen service delivery.

Work with sales, business development, and customer service teams to coordinate activities and ensure that operational priorities support the company's business goals.

Review existing procedures and introduce improvements where needed, including the use of lean management principles to improve workflow and resource utilization.

Manage and support department managers, provide clear direction, and follow up on operational responsibilities and performance.

Work with senior leadership on business planning, resource allocation, and decisions that affect the company's operations and long term development.

Address operational challenges, resolve internal coordination issues, and ensure that important projects and business activities stay on track.

Experience and Qualifications

Demonstrated experience in operations management, business management, or a related management position, with a strong record of supervising teams and overseeing daily business activities.

Experience managing department managers, coordinating multiple business functions, and maintaining accountability across an organization.

Strong understanding of financial management, profit and loss oversight, operating budgets, and financial performance analysis.

Ability to interpret financial reports, analyze operational data, and use Microsoft Excel to support business decisions.

Experience with strategic planning, project management, process improvement, and operational performance management.

Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to guide managers, develop employees, and address business challenges.

A practical understanding of sales operations, business development, and customer service.

Familiarity with lean management principles and continuous improvement practices is valuable.

Good organizational skills, sound business judgment, and the ability to manage competing priorities while keeping teams focused on results.

Pay: $158,200.00 - $222,200.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
Overview:

The Director of Operations is responsible for overseeing and coordinating operations across all markets to ensure projects are properly planned, staffed, resourced, and executed safely, efficiently, and profitably. This position provides leadership and support to regional operations, field supervision, project management, and estimating while maintaining a strong focus on customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and company growth.

Responsibilities:

* **Scheduling & Resource Allocation:** Oversee companywide project scheduling, prioritize work, and allocate crews, equipment, and resources across all markets to maximize efficiency and utilization.
* **Crew Staffing & Workforce Planning:** Coordinate staffing needs, crew assignments, and workforce development to ensure adequate personnel are available to meet project demands.
* **Project Management & Estimating:** Provide oversight and direction to project management and estimating teams, ensuring accurate project handoffs, effective execution, cost control, and profitability.
* **Regional & Field Support:** Support regional managers and field supervisors with operational decisions, project execution, personnel management, and day-to-day challenges.
* **Material Forecasting & Planning:** Coordinate material forecasts, procurement planning, and delivery schedules to ensure timely availability of stabilization materials while minimizing downtime and costs.
* **Jobsite Troubleshooting:** Provide hands-on support in resolving field challenges involving soil conditions, equipment, production, scheduling, and constructability.
* **Engineering & Value Engineering:** Collaborate with engineers, customers, and project teams to identify value engineering (VE) opportunities and cost-effective stabilization solutions.
* **Preconstruction Planning:** Lead coordination between estimating, project management, and field operations to ensure project scope, schedules, manpower, equipment, materials, and potential risks are addressed before mobilization.
* **Customer Relationships:** Maintain a customer-focused approach, support key customer relationships, resolve project concerns, and ensure commitments are met.
* **Operational & Financial Performance:** Monitor project profitability, productivity, equipment utilization, scheduling performance, and operational costs while driving continuous improvement.
* **Safety & Quality:** Promote consistent safety standards, quality workmanship, accountability, and best operational practices across all markets.

Qualifications:

* **Qualifications**

 + 10+ years of experience in soil stabilization, heavy civil construction, earthwork, or related specialty contracting.
 + Proven experience managing multiple projects, crews, and geographic markets.
 + Strong understanding of construction operations, scheduling, equipment utilization, project management, and estimating.
 + Knowledge of soil stabilization methods, materials, equipment, and field applications preferred.
 + Strong leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
 + Ability to balance strategic planning with hands-on field support and operational decision-making.
 + Willingness to travel between markets and project locations as needed.

 **Key Performance Expectations**

 + Maximize crew and equipment utilization across all markets.
 + Maintain effective scheduling and project readiness.
 + Improve project productivity and profitability.
 + Minimize operational downtime and resource conflicts.
 + Strengthen regional and field leadership performance.
 + Deliver consistent quality and customer satisfaction.
 + Support sustainable company growth through efficient operations.

People Promise:

**Our People Promise**

Our commitment to Our People is key to the success of our business. We respect the differences between us, and we leverage those differences to create an environment where all employees feel welcome and fairly treated. We seek the best solutions possible by attracting and engaging a diverse workforce where all perspectives are sought out and valued.

*Mt. Carmel Stabilization Group is an equal employment opportunity employer committed to providing equal opportunity for both applicants and employees. Mt. Carmel Stabilization Group prohibits unlawful discrimination or harassment of employees and applicants based on race, creed, color, national origin, sex, age (40+), religion, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, genetic information, citizenship status, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic, all employment decisions, including but not limited to recruitment, hiring, compensation, training, apprenticeship, promotion, demotion, transfer, lay-off and termination, and all other terms and conditions of employment. Mt. Carmel Stabilization Group's practices and policies are administered under applicable federal, state, and local laws.*

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
Livingston Associates has partnered with an established company, made up of highly skilled, capable individuals who are looking to add a Director of Operations to their growing team! 
 
**Position Summary:** 
The Director of Operations is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operations for a specialty contractor with multiple offices in NYS, ensuring projects are executed safely, efficiently, and profitably. This role partners closely with the CEO/Owner to translate strategic goals into executable plans across field operations, labor, scheduling, safety, compliance, and internal processes.. This position should be filled with a proven hands-on leader who can operate independently, make sound business decisions, manage multiple operational priorities, and contribute strategically to the company's overall success. 
 
**Compensation:**

* **$**130,000-$160,000 per year

 
**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Operations & Field Execution**:
 + Oversee daily operations across all projects, ensuring schedules, budgets, and quality standards are met
 + Coordinate closely with Field Operations, Safety & Compliance and project managers to support successful project delivery
 + Resolve operational issues impacting productivity, customer satisfaction, or safety
 + Ensure materials, labor, equipment are properly aligned with project needs
* **Financial & Performance Management**
 + Support job cost controls, labor efficiency, and margin performance
 + Monitor KPIs related to productivity, safety, schedule adherence, and profitability
 + Collaborate with accounting and project teams on forecasting, labor planning, and cash flow management
* **Labor & Workforce Management**
 + Partner with field operations for workforce planning, labor projections, and staffing levels
 + Support hiring, onboarding, training, and development of field and operations staff
 + Foster a culture of accountability, teamwork, and high performance
* **Safety, Compliance & Risk Management**
 + Partner with safety & compliance team to ensure compliance with OSHA, regulatory requirements, and company safety programs
 + Promote a strong safety-first culture across all field and office operations
 + Identify and mitigate operational and contractual risks
* **Process Improvement & Systems**
 + Develop, implement, and refine operational processes to improve efficiency and scalability
 + Lead adoption of tools, technology, and systems that streamline operations and reporting
 + Standardize best practices across projects and teams
* **Leadership & Strategy**
 + Partner with the CEO on strategic planning, growth initiatives, and operational alignment
 + Provide leadership, mentorship, and direction to operations team members
 + Support customer relationships and assist with issue resolution as needed

 
**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field preferred. Equivalent industry experience will be considered.
* Minimum of 10–15 years of progressive experience in commercial construction or specialty contracting.
* Minimum of 5–7 years in a senior operational leadership position with direct responsibility for project execution, personnel management, and financial performance.
* Demonstrated success managing operations for a construction company or division generating $20M–$40M+ in annual revenue.
* Experience overseeing multiple project teams and simultaneous projects across various geographic markets.

 
**Benefits & Incentives:**

* Paid time off

new_roles.title: Director of Pharmacy Operations
new_roles.description:
**Onco360 is continuing to grow, and we're seeking new team members. Join a mission-driven team making a difference in the lives of cancer patients.**

Our Onco360 Pharmacy has a need for a Director of Pharmacy Operations!

**Starting Pay:** **$160k and up, depending on experience** 
**Employment:** Full-Time

**Current Available Schedule:**

**Monday - Friday - 8am - 4:30pm EST**

**Onco360 Pharmacy is a unique oncology pharmacy model created to serve the needs of community, oncology and hematology physicians, patients, payers, and manufacturers.**

**We offer a variety of benefits** including: Medical; Dental; Vision; 401k opportunity; Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays; Tuition Reimbursement; Company paid benefits – life insurance; and short and long-term disability

A career with us is more than just a job. It's an opportunity to connect and care for our patients, providers, communities and each other. We attract extraordinary people who have a strong desire to live our mission - to better the lives of those battling cancer and rare diseases. Compassion is more important than numbers. We value teamwork, respect, integrity, and passion.

We succeed when you do, and our company and management team work hard to foster an environment that provides you with opportunities for both professional and personal growth.

***The Director of Pharmacy Operations will be responsible for the operation, direction, coordination, evaluation and management of the Pharmacy Operation. In addition, the Director of Pharmacy Operations will be responsible for the organization and implementation of policies and procedures that are established. The Director of Pharmacy Operations will participate in and oversee the pharmaceutical services to oncology patients in a manner that maximizes quality and patient safety.***

Director of Pharmacy Operations Major Responsibilities:

* Working in collaboration with Senior Director of Pharmacy Operations, the Director of Pharmacy Operations will determine the day-to-day priorities for the pharmacy staff and adjust those priorities as need be to meet the high touch needs of the pharmacy’s patients.
* The Director of Pharmacy Operations will ensure that prescription orders process through daily workflow in a timely manner
* Assists Senior Director in monitoring day-to-day pharmacy operations and driving workflow to ensure that the accurate and timely dispensing of quality pharmacy services is consistently delivered to all customers/residents using effective service leadership and customer skills.
* Develops creative solutions to workflow and process challenges and works with Senior Director and Operations Staff to implement changes or enhancements to process.
* Oversee workflow and coordinate with managers/supervisors/vertical leads on productivity and staff allocation to ensure timely prescription processing and accountability of performance
* Manages staff in a leadership role to maintain a positive working environment by creating synergy and teamwork to minimize employee relations issues and reduce turnover. Communicates effectively with coworkers and customers, and successfully resolves issues.
* Works with pharmacy management to control operating expenses by effective utilization of personnel, equipment and supplies to maintain and improve services within approved budget.
* Plan, organize and ensure adherence to Onco360 pharmacy policies and procedures.
* Interview, select and supervise the activities of the pharmacy staff; communicate interpret and discuss with staff policies and procedures.
* Determine job objectives, work methods and performance standards; review performance relative to departmental objectives; authorize and communicate salary changes, promotions, transfers, discipline and discharge and administer all other personnel actions when necessary to maintain consistent and productive workflow in the pharmacy.
* Appropriately recognize organizational lines within the department; keep employees informed of matters affecting their work and interest; interpret and explain policies and procedures, department objectives, operations, services, organization, budget and seek comments and suggestions form employees.
* Assure that professional competence of staff is maintained through education and coordination with senior staff. Plan for both short and long-range goals of the department in concert with the whole organizational plan of Onco360.
* Collaborates with healthcare team to provide clinical and technical support as needed.
* Delegate authority to pharmacy technicians to accomplish pharmacist supervised tasks. Provide authorization for supervision, orientation, training, job objectives, performance standards and appraisal, personal development, safety, communication, discipline, scheduling, grievances and other personnel actions.
* Provide for maintenance of appropriate records to assure that the quality, quantity and timeliness of work done is documented. Review and appraise work of others within the department; review and evaluate departmental performance; keep Senior Director informed of the department’s progress and problems and any significant factors affecting assigned responsibilities.
* Maintain competency in care for patients of all age groups and developmental stages, and maintain competency as specifically indicated by orientation guidelines for a unit.
* Conducts job responsibilities in accordance with the standards set out in the Company’s Code of Business Conduct and Ethics, its policies and procedures, the Corporate Compliance Agreement, applicable federal and state laws, and applicable professional standards.
* The Director of Pharmacy Operations will adhere to all State and Federal laws and regulations with accepted standards of Onco360’s good pharmacy practices.
* Documentation of adverse events and products complaints per contractual obligations to pharmaceutical manufacturers.
* Other duties as required.

 

**Director of Pharmacy Operations Position Qualifications:**

Education/Learning Experience

* Required: High school diploma or equivalent. Combination of education, training, and relevant operational leadership experience sufficient to perform the responsibilities of the role.
* Desired: Bachelor’s degree (BSPh or Doctorate of Pharmacy (PharmD).

Work Experience

* Required: Required: 5+ years of progressive pharmacy experience, including experience leading teams, projects, or operational initiatives.
* Desired: 7+ years of progressive pharmacy experience. Specialty pharmacy experience.

Skills/Knowledge

* Required: Knowledge of pharmacy laws and federal and state regulations. Ability to work cooperatively as a member of a team. Extensive experience working in CPR+. Effective communication, problem-solving, and professional decision-making skills
* Desired: Previous leadership experience, competency with various Microsoft platforms (Excel, Word, Outlook), Ability to analyze performance data, identify trends, and implement improvements

Licenses/Certifications

* Required: Certified Pharmacy Technician license (CPhT) or RPH license in applicable state(s).
* Desired: Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT), Advanced Certified Pharmacy Technician (CPhT-Adv), Multi-State RPh licenses, Certified Specialty Pharmacist (CSP)

**Company Values: Teamwork, Respect, Integrity, Passion**

new_roles.title: Director of Operations / Master Orchestrator Wanted
new_roles.description:
**The Director of Operations/Master Orchestrator** we want on our Pro Roofers Dream Team is someone who thrives on turning all the moving parts into a well-oiled machine! You are a natural leader who sees the big picture without ever losing sight of the details. Where others see obstacles, you see solutions. Where others see disorganization, you see an opportunity to build a better system.

You get a genuine sense of satisfaction from watching a team operate at its best because you've put the right people, processes, and expectations in place. You love numbers because they tell a story, and you know how to use that story to make things better. You're not afraid to roll up your sleeves, tackle a problem head-on, or have the tough conversations that keep everyone moving forward.

You're organized without being rigid and driven without losing your good nature. You know how to bring out the best in people while holding them accountable for results. You're a builder of systems, a solver of problems, and a master of follow-through. Most importantly, you take genuine pride in creating an operation that runs smoothly, profitably, and with excellence.

Job Duties/Responsibilities

* Be the driving force behind the day-to-day operations of Pro Roofers, ensuring everything runs efficiently from signed contract to completed project and final payment.
* Lead, support, and hold production teams accountable for completing jobs on time, within budget, and to our high standards of quality.
* Masterfully coordinate scheduling, material ordering, production, quality control, and billing to keep every job moving forward.
* Develop and maintain quality control processes that ensure exceptional workmanship and customer satisfaction.
* Keep a watchful eye on the production pipeline, anticipating problems and removing bottlenecks before they become costly.
* Track job costs, profit margins, and operational performance. You know your numbers and use them to make smart decisions!
* Create and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) that keep the team focused on measurable results.
* Keep our CRM accurate, organized, and functioning as a valuable management tool.
* Lead productive team meetings and individual check-ins that create clarity, accountability, and momentum.
* Build, document, and continually improve systems that make our operations more efficient and scalable.
* Embrace technology, software, and AI tools to simplify processes and help our team work smarter.
* Partner with our sales leadership to ensure a seamless transition from the sale to successful project completion.
* Cultivate a team environment built on trust, excellence, personal responsibility, and a shared commitment to success.

Qualifications

* Proven experience managing operations in the roofing or solar industry.
* A natural ability to lead people, build strong relationships, and inspire accountability.
* Exceptional organizational skills with an almost instinctive ability to identify what needs attention.
* A strong understanding of job costing, profit margins, budgets, and operational performance metrics.
* A numbers-driven mindset. You appreciate accurate data and know how to turn it into actionable improvements.
* Experience implementing and improving operational systems and procedures.
* Confidence working with CRM systems and business management software.
* An appreciation for emerging technology, including AI, and its ability to improve business efficiency.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to navigate challenging conversations with professionalism.
* A commitment to quality, consistency, and doing things right the first time.
* A proactive, solution-oriented attitude. You don't wait for someone else to fix a problem. You take ownership and get it done!
* Willingness to work long hours during the busy season.
* Agility to climb on a roof and walk the ridge.

Job Details

Position: Director of Operations

Location: Kansas City Area (On-site and in the field)

Job Type: Full-time

Compensation: 90, 000–130,000 annually, depending on experience

Competitive Compensation and Other Perks

A competitive salary that recognizes the value of your experience and leadership.

A positive, uplifting work environment focused on trust, service, excellence, teamwork, and growth.

A meaningful leadership position where your ideas, decisions, and contributions directly impact the company's success.

The opportunity to build and shape systems that support a growing and successful business.

The satisfaction of working alongside a motivated sales leader who values your operational expertise and trusts you to lead.

Professional growth opportunities as you help take Pro Roofers to the next level.

About Pro Roofers

The team at Pro Roofers brings over 20 years of residential and commercial roofing experience to the Kansas City area. We have built our reputation by delivering on our promises, doing quality work, and treating our customers and their homes with the care and respect they deserve. We have over 500 five star reviews and have earned every one of them by adhering to excellence.

At Pro Roofers, we believe that exceptional results come from exceptional people working together toward a common goal. We are guided by the principles of trust, growth, excellence, teamwork, and service.

We also understand the value of your home life and your work life, and we seek to enhance both. As part of the Pro Roofers Dream Team, your leadership will matter and your contributions will make a difference.

We're not just looking for someone to manage operations. We're looking for someone who will take ownership, build something exceptional, and take pride in the success of the entire team.

Ready to Work Your Magic? If you're the kind of leader who gets excited about building great systems, developing great people, and turning operational challenges into measurable success, we want to meet you!

To Apply: Send your resume along with a short note describing an operational process you built or improved, and the results it produced.

We can't wait to meet the next Master Orchestrator of our Pro Roofers Dream Team!

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $90,000.00 - $130,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Experience:

* Operations Coordination: 3 years (Preferred)
* Roofing: 1 year (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Blue Springs, MO 64015 (Preferred)

Ability to Relocate:

* Blue Springs, MO 64015: Relocate before starting work (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

new_roles.title: Director of Brokerage Operations
new_roles.description:
**Make your next move an expert one.**

At Colliers it’s not our success that sets us apart, it’s how we achieve it. Our people are passionate, take ownership and always do what’s right for our clients, people and communities.

**Why Colliers?**

Our enterprising environment needs your expertise to facilitate Colliers’ continued growth as an industry leader. Our nimble, decentralized culture can provide you with a wealth of opportunities to learn about our business and quickly gain experience to accelerate your career.

***\*\*this is an on-site opportunity based out of our Atlanta, GA office\* \****

 

**About the role**

The Director, Brokerage Operations will lead the effective and consistent delivery of operational excellence across the office and serve as the local integrator for the business. The role will lead through influence across a matrixed organization, coordinating local, regional and national resources to achieve business objectives around producers and the point of sale, regardless of reporting structure. The Director will oversee the day-to-day operating and administrative requirements for local business lines while maintaining clear accountability for outcomes.

As a key member of the local leadership team, the Director will organize enablement around winning business, recruiting, retention and producer effectiveness. The role will use the broader Colliers platform aggressively where it can deliver work better or more efficiently, while ensuring strong local execution and continuous improvement in service delivery.

 

**In this position, you will..**

* Lead and manage operations support employees across departments, ensuring service excellence, efficient delivery, clear accountability and continuous improvement in all service areas.
* Lead adoption of enterprise technology platforms, automation initiatives and process improvements to drive scalability, producer efficiency and operational effectiveness.
* Bring strong operating and financial rigor to the business in collaboration with the local Managing Director, including P&L management, budgeting, forecasting, capital planning, financial analysis and resource allocation. Partner with Finance on transactional processes without making transactional Finance the center of the role.
* Serve as a strategic business partner to the Managing Director, supporting office revenue growth through producer recruiting, onboarding and integration, retention, producer productivity and pursuit conversion. Coordinate supporting resources and deliverables, including pitch books, recruiting materials and meeting preparation.
* Maintain an effective audit process to ensure local revenue recognition and other key controls are followed in accordance with company and GAAP guidelines.

* Partner with the local Managing Director on annual business planning, growth and market expansion, workforce planning and execution of strategic priorities, translating priorities into recommendations and action while ensuring corporate policies and procedures are followed.

* Operate proactively and decisively across a matrix, resolving issues at the appropriate level and making difficult calls rather than routinely pushing decisions upward.
* Integrate local, regional and national resources, including Client Services, analysts, People Services, Marketing, Research, IT, Operations and Finance, around producers and the point of sale. Leverage the broader Colliers platform for better, more efficient delivery while retaining clear local accountability.
* Responsible for partnering with corporate Human Resources on implementing Human Resources activities for all personnel including recruitment, selection, orientation, training, and performance management of the brokerage support team.
* Manage the administration and submission to People Services and/or Commission Payroll of all documentation for new and departing employees.
* Ensure effective workplace operations, facilities management and business continuity through appropriate delegation, vendor management and operational oversight.

new_roles.title: Director Engineering Operational Excellence
new_roles.description:
**Job ID: 116026**

 

The Leonardo DRS Naval Electronics business provides leading naval computing infrastructure, network and data distribution and middleware enterprise services, as well as world-class manufacturing and support capabilities.

**Business Unit**: Naval Electronics
 
**Location**: Eagan, MN
 
**Career Functional Area**: Engineering
 
**Telework Type**: Hybrid
 
**Travel Expectation**: 30%
 
**Schedule**: 9/80

**Job Summary**
---------------

Responsible for establishing and continuously improving the processes, tools, and data-management practices that enable disciplined, compliant, and efficient engineering execution across all programs. Own engineering configuration-management standards, processes and execution releasing the E BOM. Monitor the quality of engineering deliverables identifying opportunities of improvement.

**Job Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Engineering Process Ownership and Excellence**

* Define, deploy, maintain, and continuously improve standardized engineering processes, procedures, work instructions, templates
* Ensure engineering processes are practical for program execution while meeting applicable customer, contractual, quality, regulatory, cybersecurity, and internal requirements.
* Establish process ownership, approval authorities, compliance expectations, training requirements, and periodic process-review cycles.
* Lead process maturity assessments, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and implement corrective and preventive improvements.

**Engineering Tools and Digital Strategy**

* Define the engineering tools strategy, roadmap, governance model, and deployment plans in partnership with Engineering, IT, Quality, Supply Chain, and program teams.
* Lead deployment, adoption, administration requirements, user support models, and continuous improvement of engineering tools, including product lifecycle management, requirements management, analysis, collaboration, and configuration-management tools.
* Ensure tools, workflows, data structures, and integrations support disciplined engineering execution, traceability, release control, and reliable engineering data.
* Capture user and program needs; prioritize enhancements, integrations, and new capabilities based on business value, risk reduction, compliance, and program demand.

**Engineering Configuration Management**

* Own the engineering configuration-management process, standards, governance, and associated tool workflows.
* Establish common rules for engineering baselines, configuration identification, revision control, change management, release authorization, and configuration-status accounting.
* Ensure configuration-management processes support full traceability between requirements, drawings, parts, assemblies, bills of material, changes, verification evidence, and released product definition.
* Define the governance framework for configuration control boards and ensure appropriate technical, quality, programmatic, manufacturing, supply-chain, and customer inputs are incorporated where required.

**Job Responsibilities (Cont.)**
--------------------------------

**Program Configuration-Management Support**

* Provide configuration-management process leadership and tailored support to programs from proposal through product support.
* Support development, review, and maintenance of program Configuration Management Plans and related configuration-management deliverables.
* Establish program-specific configuration baselines, release schedules, change-control workflows, approval matrices, and reporting appropriate to contractual and product requirements.
* Support programs in resolving configuration-management issues, ensuring timely decisions and minimizing release, production, and customer-impact risk.

**Product-Definition Data Integrity**

* Govern the processes for drawing-number creation, part-number assignment, nomenclature, document classification, and engineering-data release.
* Ensure new drawing and part numbers are created, controlled, and uniquely identified in accordance with approved standards and system rules.
* Establish validation controls for engineering drawings, parts, assemblies, and engineering bills of material (EBOMs), including consistency, completeness, revision alignment, and traceability.
* Monitor the integrity of released product-definition data and drive resolution of discrepancies that could affect procurement, manufacturing, verification, sustainment, or customer deliverables.

**Engineering Deliverable Quality and Performance Monitoring**

* Define the quality criteria, review expectations, and performance measures for engineering deliverables.
* Monitor the quality, completeness, timeliness, and first-pass acceptance of engineering outputs, including requirements artifacts, drawings, specifications, analysis reports, test documentation, change packages, and released product data.
* Analyze defects, rework, late changes, release escapes, configuration discrepancies, and recurring nonconformities to identify systemic causes and improvement opportunities.
* Provide leadership with regular visibility into engineering-process performance, deliverable quality trends, compliance risks, and recommended corrective actions.

**Continuous Improvement and Assurance**

* Lead improvement initiatives that strengthen engineering execution, reduce rework, improve data quality, and increase delivery predictability.
* Develop and recommend improvement actions based on performance data, audit findings, lessons learned, user feedback, program needs, and changes in business or customer requirements.
* Verify the effectiveness of implemented improvements and maintain an actionable backlog of process, tool, and data-governance enhancements.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining objective evidence of process compliance, configuration control, tool governance, and engineering-data integrity.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline; advanced degree or relevant professional certification preferred
* 10+ years of progressive experience in engineering, engineering operations, configuration management, PLM, quality, or systems engineering within a complex and regulated product environment.
* 5+ years in a leadership role responsible for engineering processes, tools, configuration management, quality, or operational excellence.
* Experience developing and deploying engineering processes, governance controls, workflows, and performance measures.
* Experience leading implementation and improvement of engineering tools, including PLM, requirements-management, design-data management, and configuration-management systems.
* Practical experience with Configuration Management Plans, engineering change control, drawing and part-number management, release control, and EBOM validation.
* Proven record of improving engineering deliverable quality, data integrity, process compliance, and operational efficiency

**Additional Qualifications**
-----------------------------

* Strong knowledge of engineering product-development processes, configuration management, product-data control, and engineering release practices.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders in a matrix organization.
* Strong analytical, communication, and continuous-improvement skills

**U.S. Citizenship required. This position requires an active DOD security clearance or the ability to obtain such clearance within a reasonable time after commencement of employment.**

*The salary range for this position is $161,180/year- $250,000/year. This range reflects the good faith estimate of pay the employer is willing to offer at the time of posting. Several factors can influence the pay scale, including but not limited to: Federal contract labor categories and contract wage rates, collective bargaining agreements, geographic location, business considerations, scope, and responsibilities of the position, local or other applicable market conditions, and internal equity. Other factors include the candidate’s qualifications such as prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education/training, and certifications. In addition to base pay, employees may be eligible for: annual performance-based bonuses, equity awards, and overtime pay (for non-exempt employees as applicable. Our benefits package includes comprehensive health insurance (medical, dental, vision), employer matching 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off including vacation, holidays, and sick leave (including ant state-mandated paid sick leave), parental leave benefits, tuition reimbursement, professional development support, and life and disability insurance coverage.*

 

*Taking care of our people is a top priority at Leonardo DRS. We are proud to offer competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a company contribution to a health savings account, telemedicine, life and disability insurance, legal insurance, and a 401(k) savings plan. We champion wellness programs that focus on physical, emotional, and financial well-being. We develop our talent by offering programs and activities to support career-growth, professional development, and skill enhancement. And we understand there is more to life than work, and the importance of offering flexible work schedules with our 9/80 program, competitive vacation, health/emergency leave, paid parental leave, and community service hours.* 

* *Some employees are eligible for limited benefits only*

 

*Leonardo DRS, Inc. and its subsidiaries provide equal opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.*

new_roles.title: Director of Branch Operations
new_roles.description:
**Eagle Title | Annapolis, MD**

**Reports To:** President

**Compensation Range:** Compensation is a combination of base salary plus performance-based commission tied to profitability and revenue growth across the branches.

**POSITION SUMMARY**

Eagle Title is looking for a Director of Branch Operations to lead the profitability, growth, and operational excellence of Eagle Title branches (including Commercial and Builder Services Divisions).

Reporting directly to the President, this is a senior leadership role for someone who combines strong business acumen, operational expertise, and a proven ability to develop high-performing leaders. We're looking for someone who takes ownership of results, holds branch managers accountable for growing their businesses, and builds the strategies, systems, and relationships needed for long-term success.

The right person understands that strong financial performance starts with strong leadership, clear expectations, efficient operations, and exceptional client service.

**WHAT YOU'LL LEAD**

**Branch Profitability & Growth**

* Own the profit and loss (P&L) performance of all branches, driving profitability, revenue growth, and operational efficiency.
* Establish financial goals, growth expectations, and key performance indicators (KPIs) for each branch.
* Hold branch managers accountable for executing strategies that grow the business, strengthen referral relationships, and achieve revenue targets.
* Regularly review branch financial and operational performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement strategies that deliver measurable results.

**Branch Operations & Strategy**

* Provide strategic and operational oversight of branches, ensuring consistency, accountability, efficiency, and exceptional client service.
* Support branch managers in overseeing day-to-day operations, resolving challenges, and maintaining effective workflows.
* Develop and execute branch strategies that align with Eagle Title's financial goals and long-term business objectives.
* Establish standardized processes, performance expectations, and operational best practices across locations.
* Leverage technology, data, and continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen efficiency, quality, and scalability.

**Leadership & Accountability**

* Lead, coach, and develop branch managers through clear expectations, regular performance discussions, measurable goals, and consistent accountability.
* Establish and monitor branch manager scorecards that track financial performance, business development activity, operational efficiency, and client satisfaction.
* Partner with Human Resources to support staffing, training, performance management, and leadership development.
* Empower branch managers to take ownership of their teams, business development efforts, and overall branch performance.
* Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.

**Collaboration & Business Performance**

* Serve as a strategic business partner to Underwriting, Post-Closing, Marketing and other operational departments to strengthen workflows, resolve challenges, and deliver exceptional client experience.
* Collaborate with the President and Sales leadership to align branch growth strategies with overall company objectives.
* Identify and address operational challenges affecting transaction quality, turnaround times, profitability, and client satisfaction.
* Strengthen communication and collaboration across departments to support successful transactions and organizational growth.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* Proven leadership experience overseeing multiple branches, locations, or business units with responsibility for financial and operational performance.
* Strong understanding of P&L management, budgeting, financial analysis, and revenue growth strategies.
* Demonstrated success driving profitability, operational efficiency, and measurable business results.
* Experience coaching, developing, and holding managers accountable for business growth and operational performance.
* Strong strategic thinking with the ability to translate business goals into actionable plans.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and decision-making skills.
* Experience developing and monitoring KPIs, scorecards, and operational performance metrics.
* Ability to balance financial performance, operational priorities, employee development, and exceptional client service.
* Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across departments and leadership levels.
* Experience in title insurance, real estate settlement, or a related industry strongly preferred.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, Finance, or a related field preferred.
* Experience with title production technology, including Qualia, preferred.

new_roles.title: Director of Production
new_roles.description:
MHI Ship Repair & Services is a major marine repair and conversion contractor serving the U.S. Navy, Military Sealift Command, Maritime Administration and Commercial ship owners and operators worldwide. Our shipyard is conveniently located in the Mid-Atlantic region at the port of Hampton Roads, Norfolk Virginia.

**JOB SUMMARY:** Manages the operations of all production trades to include Facilities and Gas Free. Responsible for ensuring that all projects are manned with competent, properly trained and certified personnel, and the work efforts are coordinated and executed in a cost-effective manner, safely, and on time. Provides leadership and guidance to Shop Superintendants and oversees the maintenance and improvement of all shop equipment and development of shop procedures.

**SUPERVISES:** All Shop Superintendents

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Primary oversight of all production departments to include Facilities and Gas Free. Responsible for making strategic and tactical decisions related to certain aspects of MHI's production business to include operation non-Program work
* Responsible for ensuring that all projects are manned with competent, properly trained and certified personnel, and that work efforts are prioritized, coordinated and efforts integrated between departments and executed safely, in a cost-effective manner and on time.
* Ensures performance is within the guidelines of the contracts, delivery orders are received and that all contractual requirements are within the scope of work for the specific market and are met for U.S. Navy, Government, private shipyard, and commercial projects.
* Holds daily production meetings with all trades and Project Managers. Communicate with all department heads to ensure that any manning, scheduling, tooling, and material issues are identified and resolved.
* Attend all SRA Production Meetings.
* Walks through all in plant vessels daily verifying all work in progress and identifying and resolving any issues as they arise.
* Provides leadership and guidance to Shop Superintendants and oversees the maintenance and improvement of all shop equipment and development of shop procedures.
* Reviews and proofreads specs.

**ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Estimating as requested.
* May on occasion be required to manage a project.
* Performs other related duties as assigned by supervisor.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS**

* College education and 15 years progressive experience in the maritime industry. (Apprenticeship and practical experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.) Prior management experience a must.
* Ability to estimate.
* Basic knowledge of all skilled trades, and ability to manage effectively.
* Ability to communicate effectively as a leader.

MHI Ship Repair & Services offers competitive wages and an excellent benefit package.

Affirmative Action/EOE Employer of protected veterans and individuals with disabilities.
